sloka: तेन चैव तदा तुल्यं सहासीनाः सभासदः ।आसनेभ्यः समुत्तस्थुः पूजयन्तः पुरोहितम् ॥२-५-२४॥
transliteration: tena caiva tadā tulyaṁ sahāsīnāḥ sabhāsadaḥ ।āsanebhyaḥ samuttasthuḥ pūjayantaḥ purohitam ॥2-5-24॥

translations.english: All those present in the assembly with him (the king) also got up from their seats as he (Dasaratha) did and paid their obeisance to Vasistha.
